title: Generation input without a standard is rejected at the shared contract
turnSequence: Teacher submits a lesson request with a prompt, grade 4, and language en but no standardId.
The delivery seam parses the body with lessonGenerationInputSchema (src/shared/generation-contract.ts:28).
expected: The shared contract rejects the input (zod issue on standardId) and the delivery seam maps a parse failure to 422 INVALID_INPUT (src/server/generation/delivery.server.ts:65-70). No generation record is created; nothing reaches the provider.
observableFailure: The contract accepts a request with no captured goal standard, or the rejection is not 422, or a record is created anyway.
